verdict.rationale: Simular's Sai is documented to rerun taught tasks on a schedule (simular-docs-15) and to keep working on cloud computers after you close your laptop, notifying you via iMessage or Telegram when it needs approval (simular-docs-16, simular-docs-22, simular-docs-14). That background autonomy is reinforced by replayable parameterized skills (simular-docs-8), self-healing reruns (simular-docs-9), persistent sessions (simular-docs-19) and up to 5 concurrent cloud computers (simular-docs-13). missing for 10: detailed documentation of schedule/trigger configuration (e.g., cron or event triggers), independent or hands-on corroboration that unattended scheduled runs work reliably.
